* recommended;  ~ statistically indistinguishable from the recommended design (< 2 SE): choose on other grounds.
Sensitivity: worst-case values above are the maximum over the stress scenarios good_iface_low_kf, good_iface_high_kf, poor_iface_low_kf, poor_iface_high_kf (stress cases, not probabilities).
Design map (Q1): within the supported interface range the leading candidate is small_particles_aligned; 100% of map cells cannot distinguish the top two.
Configuration files written to results/recommendation/ (solve one with `tcid solve <file>`).

Modelled domain: 2D cross-section of a cured particle-filled epoxy layer between isothermal faces with insulated sidewalls; steady linear conduction; isotropic alumina-like development filler (NOT boron nitride); area fraction (not a 3D volume fraction); particle-matrix interface resistance and filler conductivity treated as stress scenarios, not probabilities; outer contacts added in series. Not modelled: 3D connectivity, BN anisotropy, viscosity/processing, adhesion, cure, dielectric breakdown, stress, ageing. Not a qualified adhesive.
